**PT PMA Requirements (PP 5/2021):**
- Minimum total investment: IDR 10 billion (~USD 625,000)
- Minimum paid-up capital: IDR 2.5 billion per shareholder (~USD 156,000)
- Can be invested over time, not all upfront

## Visa Types Explained (Per Keputusan Menteri M.IP-08.GR.01.01/2025)

### KITAS (Temporary Stay Permit)
- **E28A (Investor)**: For PT PMA shareholders with minimum IDR 10 billion shareholding
- **E25B (Director)**: For PT PMA directors - requires RPTKA
- **E23 (Worker/Employee)**: For employees with RPTKA approval
- **E33G (Remote Worker)**: For digital nomads working for foreign employers
- **E33F/E33E (Retirement)**: Age 55+, proof of pension/income

### KITAP (Permanent Stay Permit)
- After holding KITAS for consecutive years (typically 4-5 years)
- Available for investors, retirees, spouses of Indonesian citizens

### Important Notes
- Old visa codes C312, C313, B211A are NO LONGER valid
- Current classification follows Keputusan Menteri M.IP-08.GR.01.01 Tahun 2025
- All visa applications now processed through immigration digital systems

## KBLI 2025 (Business Classification)

Indonesia adopted KBLI 2025 (BPS Regulation 7/2025) replacing KBLI 2020.
- **Deadline for migration**: June 18, 2026
- **OSS**: Not yet integrated with KBLI 2025 (as of February 2026)
- **Strategy**: Prepare documentation now, execute when OSS system is updated
- All consulting codes (70201-70209): TERBUKA, 100% foreign ownership
- All IT consulting codes (62201, 62204, 62209): TERBUKA, 100% foreign ownership
- Real estate sector: expanded from 5 to 14 codes, all 100% PMA

## Can foreigners own property in Indonesia?
No, foreigners cannot own freehold land (Hak Milik). However, foreigners CAN:
- Own buildings on Hak Pakai (Right to Use) land - up to 80 years
- Hold long-term leases (Hak Sewa) - typically 25-30 years
- Own property through a PT PMA company (Hak Guna Bangunan)
